# Manual Dev Deploy

- **Status:** Complete

## Problem Statement

Every push deploys to the shared dev environment, so a broken branch breaks dev for everyone.

## Acceptance Criteria

```gherkin
Scenario: Dev deploys only on manual dispatch
  Given an engineer pushes to a feature branch
  Then no deployment to dev occurs
  And dev deploys only when an engineer dispatches the workflow manually
```

## Behavioural Delta

Baseline: docs/specs/deployment.md

### MODIFIED

Scenario "Push deploys to dev" becomes "Dev deploys only on manual dispatch".

## Living Specifications

- docs/specs/deployment.md — owns dev deployment triggers
EOF
